[[Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles]] are a pair of [[item rarity|gold]], [[inscribable]] [[daggers]] that can be used in place of [[Brass Knuckles]] during any quest that requires [[Dwarven Brawling]] skills.

== Stats ==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])

== Acquisition ==
* [[Eye of the North]]
** [[The Throwdown in a Norn Town]] quest

== Dye ==
[[Dye]] affects the entire dagger. The daggers will become tinted to the color specified. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye.
{{dye chart}}

== Notes ==
{{main|Dwarven brawling#Recommended equipment}}
* If doing [[Dwarven brawling]] only, for best results, apply the following modifications to increase the damage substantially (along with other benefits):
** [[Inscription]]: [[Brawn over Brains]] (+15% damage; the -5 energy is irrelevant, since the loss of energy is negated by [[Dwarven Brawling]]).
** [[Dagger Tang]]: [[Vampiric]] (minor healing while fighting), [[Sundering]] (extra damage), or [[Furious]] (faster adrenaline build).
** [[Dagger Handle]]: [[of Shelter]] ([[of Defense]] is almost as useful)
** [[Customization]] (if not sharing between characters).

* If you do not meet the required rank of 9 in Dagger Mastery, these will do 1-3 dmg, less than the default Brass Knuckles.
* You can use an identification kit on this item, but it will have no effect.
